concerns.text: SC‑003 requires that the paired two‑sided t‑test p‑value be > 0.05, but no task enforces this threshold. T008 records the t‑test result but does not abort or flag a failure when p ≤ 0.05.

SC‑004 mandates a total pipeline runtime ≤ 30 minutes and an auditable runtime log, yet no task creates or validates a `runtime.log` artifact. T010 mentions a runtime log informally but provides no verification step.
